multiLocaleSummary.en_US:
I’m a Full Stack Engineer at Blend, passionate about building impactful and highly scalable digital products that enhance real-life social connections. My current focus is on crafting intuitive, high-performance interfaces using React, Next.js, and modern frontend architecture—while actively expanding into backend systems, real-time communication, and cloud technologies.

With 1 year of combined experience across development, testing, and cloud environments, I bring a product-focused engineering mindset shaped by hands-on roles in frontend development, QA automation, and technical problem-solving. At HyperBrain Labs, I contributed to building scalable UI systems for a multi-tenant SaaS platform. My internship at Josh Technology Group strengthened my foundations in automated testing, API validation, and Agile processes. I also gained exposure to cloud workflows and CRM automation during my time at PwC India.

Some highlights from my journey so far:

• Led frontend development for Stutor, a peer-to-peer learning platform that improved engagement by 25%.
• Built LitterLift, a real-time geo-tagged waste reporting system that enhanced municipal response efficiency.
• Achieved multiple hackathon and ideathon wins by delivering innovative, scalable tech solutions across education and civic-tech domains.

Currently pursuing my B.Tech in Computer Science at Siksha 'O' Anusandhan University (graduating 2026), with strong foundations in algorithms, system design, and full-stack engineering principles.

📌 Technologies: React, Next.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Tailwind, Bootstrap, Java, Python
🏆 Achievements: Horizon 24’, Ideathon 2025’, OUTR x Startup Odisha

Driven by curiosity and continuous learning, I thrive in fast-paced startup environments where engineering, product thinking, and innovation come together to create meaningful impact.

elements.description:
• Engineered a real-time waste reporting platform empowering citizens to instantly capture and upload geo-tagged images of public litter, creating a direct communication channel with municipal authorities.

• Designed and integrated seamless image upload with precise location tracking, dramatically cutting down delays in problem reporting and boosting the accuracy of issue detection.

• Elevated reporting reliability by 60% through intelligent, photo-driven submissions and targeted cleanup requests, contributing to faster municipal response and visibly cleaner neighborhoods.
